title: Grateful Dead Live at Oakland Auditorium on 1982-12-28

ai_review.summary: A high‑energy late‑1982 concert highlighted by Lazy Lightning → Supplication and a soaring Morning Dew, captured on an audience‑soundboard matrix that most fans describe as excellent despite occasional rough edges.
ai_review.review: The performance is praised for its relaxed yet creative vibe typical of the band’s end‑of‑year ’82 shows, with standout moments in Lazy Lightning into Supplication and a memorable Morning Dew. The Chris Chappell audience‑soundboard matrix is generally lauded for its clarity and balance, though a few listeners note occasional floppiness or tape imperfections.

ai_rating.rationale: Six reviews (five 5‑star, one 3‑star) overwhelmingly praise both the music and the matrix recording; only minor complaints about occasional roughness keep the rating just below perfect.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Audience/soundboard mix praised as 'terrific' and 'crisp'; some reviewers mention slight rough edges, occasional floppiness or tape issues but overall the blend is considered listenable and well‑balanced.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Energetic, relaxed and creative flow typical of late‑1982 shows; the band builds momentum early and maintains a high level of improvisational interplay through the set.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s lead on Lazy Lightning is highlighted for its sweet, confident tone and seamless transition into Supplication.
